notes: The brain's inside is now in real 3D too: every nerve cell has the form of the cells its brain structure is really made of (pyramidal cells in the cortex, Purkinje cells in the cerebellum, star-shaped cells in the deep nuclei), with their dendrites, the pathways and the impulses on them. If a phone can't do it, the earlier drawing is used automatically; it is also the fourth view of the view button.
